body.name: robust heavy-light interval handle
body.construction: Use \(I_0\) to split categories at occupancy of numerical order \(\log(en)\); use the four-coordinate factorial lift and \(\widehat R_{\mathrm L}\) on light cells; use saturated treated-control ratios with within-cell fourth-moment truncation and an observable self-normalized score on heavy cells; aggregate the two branches into \(\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}\), \(\widehat V^{\mathrm{HL}}\), and \(\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}\); return \(\widehat C^{\mathrm{HL}}=[\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}-\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}},\widehat\tau^{\mathrm{HL}}+\widehat R^{\mathrm{HL}}]\cap[-2M,2M]\).
